Additional documentation for the optim package for Octave ¶

The info version of this document is accessible, after package installation, from the Octave commandline with optim_doc().

This documentation applies to version 1.6.3 of the optim package.

The optim package is a collection of additional functions related to numerical optimization. For Octaves core optimization functions (not contained in this package) see (octave)Optimization.

  • Functions for optimization of a scalar objective function
  • Functions for optimization of a model function returning an array
  • Functions for finding the zero of a nonlinear user function
  • Functions for numerical approximation of gradients and Hessians
  • Functions for algebraic tasks common to optimization problems
